summary: Independent authorization layer: PolicyService (contracts.PolicyEngine) with fail-closed rule evaluation against a declarative policy file, HMAC grants bound to the action hash (single use), persistent approvals / limits / denied-intent tracking (SQLite), hash-chained MAC'd audit log with verifier, secret vault and broker with scrubbing, file-based pause and emergency stop, untrusted-content wrapper / context allowlist / instruction labelling, RPC service with SO_PEERCRED authorization matrix and Landlock self-confinement, launcher that runs services under their own uids, operator CLI. 190 tests (183 default CPU tests in 25 s + 7 privileged tests that create the users and switch uid). Fix round 2026-11-27 (G-sec / G-env): limits charged per declared step and per external primitive, exact approval coverage, local-address rule protecting the instance's control plane, broader spec 12.6 detectors with approval as the default for live publications, file-flag stop voids grants, WHATWG URL reading, audit head required, run policy configs/authorization.yaml (docs/EA/FIXES.md).
